title: Checklist before recommending, and debt-fund tax
objectives: Run the eight-point debt-fund checklist before recommending.
State debt-fund tax from 1 April 2023 correctly, and refer specifics to a CA.
body_md:
Checklist before recommending a debt fund: goal date → choose the category whose duration fits it. YTM (before expenses) → a rough guide to future return if rates don't move. Modified duration → how much it can move if rates move 1%. Credit profile → % in sovereign/AAA vs AA and below; check the PRC cell. Concentration → the top issuers' share of the portfolio. Expense ratio → in debt, cost is a big part of the return gap between funds. Exit load and AUM → small funds can face more liquidity pressure. Riskometer → must suit the client's risk profile. Tax (confirm with a CA): interest from FDs and bond coupons is taxed every year at the investor's slab rate. For debt mutual funds bought on or after 1 April 2023 (funds with 35% or less in equity), gains are taxed at the slab rate, with no indexation benefit. In a debt fund, tax arises only when the investor redeems, which can help with deferral and with SWPs. Rules change with Budgets; always refer specific tax questions to the client's CA.

- Goal date → category whose duration fits it
- YTM before expenses → rough guide, if rates don't move
- Modified duration → swing for a 1% rate move
- Credit profile → sovereign/AAA vs AA and below; PRC cell
- Concentration → top issuers' share
- Expense ratio → a big part of the return gap in debt
- Exit load and AUM → small funds face more liquidity pressure
- Riskometer → must suit the client's risk profile

> **Talk-track:** “Here are the three numbers I check for any debt fund: its yield, its duration and its credit quality. Let me show you each in rupees.”

> **Investor takeaway:** In debt, small differences in cost and credit quality matter more than last year's return.
example: In debt, a 0.5% cost difference matters more than in equity, because the whole return is smaller — check TER before recommending.
say: In debt, cost is a big part of the return gap between funds.
Tax arises in a debt fund only when the investor redeems.
never: Recommend a debt fund on last year's return alone.
Quote tax rules from memory without checking current rules.

check.q: For debt funds bought from 1 April 2023, gains are generally taxed:
o: Only on maturity of each bond
check.why: At slab rate, without indexation. Confirm specifics with the client's CA.

check.q: For debt funds bought on or after 1 April 2023, gains are generally taxed:
o: Only on maturity of each bond
At the slab rate, without indexation
check.why: Gains on debt funds bought on or after 1 April 2023 are taxed at slab rate with no indexation. Confirm with a CA.
